data.spiritual_meaning: Barta expresses “Son of Tarsus”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Barta total 15, reducing to 6. Number 6 is associated with responsibility, care and harmony.
